title: L113 — THE WICK THAT ERASED A WEEK
voice: You watched the chart climb for five straight days, and a single candle wick just sent the price back to where it started.
That wick was not an accident, because the orders that triggered it were already placed before the rally began.
Every long stop below the range became fuel, and the wick burned through all of them in one second flat.
The stops did not protect the traders who placed them, they funded the entry for someone who waited below.
Wicks are not noise, they are receipts. Follow KONGRAVE — the mechanics nobody explains.

caption:
You watched the chart climb for five straight days, and a single candle wick sent the price back to where it started.

That wick was not random — the orders that triggered it were placed before the rally even began. Every stop loss below the range became fuel, and the wick burned through all of them in one second.

Wicks are not noise, they are receipts.
